components.css: .glass { position: relative; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.055), rgba(255,255,255,0.018)); box-shadow: 0 18px 44px -26px rgba(0,0,0,0.85), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(135%); outline: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.035); outline-offset: 5px; } .glass::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 18% auto; height: 1px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.32), transparent); opacity: 0.6; pointer-events: none; } .panel { padding: 1.2rem 1.35rem 1.35rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; } .panel > h2 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; margin: 0 0 0.9rem; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(148,163,184,0.5); } .panel > h2::before { content: ""; width: 2px; height: 0.85rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(158,197,232,0.55); }

components.css: .card { position: relative; padding: 1rem 1.1rem 1.05rem; border-radius: 13px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.075); background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.06), rgba(255,255,255,0.015)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.11); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(130%); } .card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0.9rem; left: 0; width: 2px; height: 0.7rem; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; background: rgba(158,197,232,0.55); opacity: 0.8; } .card .num { font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2.4vw, 1.7rem); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.15; color: #f1f5f9; } .card .sub { margin-top: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(148,163,184,0.5); } .card .who { margin-top: 0.4rem; font-size: 0.72rem; color: rgba(203,213,225,0.6); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .card .who a { color: #9ec5e8; text-decoration: none; }

components.name: Header Pill
components.description: Navigation capsule; the live pill carries the Signal Mint waveform.
components.html: Today live · refreshes every 10 s
components.css: .pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: rgba(203,213,225,0.6); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.055), rgba(255,255,255,0.018)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(130%); } .wave { display: inline-flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; height: 0.85rem; } .wave span { width: 2.5px; height: 100%; border-radius: 1px; background: #6ee7b7; transform-origin: bottom; animation: wave 1.3s ease-in-out infinite; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Toggle filter built from a visually hidden checkbox plus a label. Selected state is the only filled accent surface.
components.html:
<input type="checkbox" id="f-mil" name="mil" value="1" class="chip-toggle">

components.css: .chip-toggle { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; } .chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.32rem 0.72rem; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: rgba(203,213,225,0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.055), rgba(255,255,255,0.018)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08); cursor: pointer; user-select: none; transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .chip:hover { color: #e8edf4; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); } .chip-toggle:checked + .chip { color: #07121f; border-color: #9ec5e8; background: #9ec5e8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(158,197,232,0.25), 0 4px 14px -8px rgba(158,197,232,0.7); } .chip-toggle:focus-visible + .chip { outline: 2px solid rgba(158,197,232,0.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Full-width fleet search. Known defect: does not inherit font-family and computes to Arial.
components.html: <input id="fleet-search" class="search" type="search" name="q" placeholder="Search hex, callsign, registration, type, owner, operator…" aria-label="Search fleet">
components.css: input.search { width: 100%; margin: 0.6rem 0 0.9rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; color: inherit; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.055), rgba(255,255,255,0.018)); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.09); border-radius: 10px; outline: none; backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(130%); } input.search::placeholder { color: rgba(203,213,225,0.6); } input.search:focus { border-color: rgba(158,197,232,0.55); }

components.name: Fleet Table
components.description: Recessed data table: tracked uppercase headers, tabular rows, mono hex identity column.
components.css: .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); background: rgba(6,10,16,0.32); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.84rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } th, td { padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.045); } th { font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.11em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(148,163,184,0.5); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.025); user-select: none; } th.active { color: #9ec5e8; } th.active.desc::after { content: " ▾"; font-size: 0.75em; } tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035); } td { color: rgba(232,237,244,0.85); } td:first-child { font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; color: rgba(158,197,232,0.55); }

components.name: Hour Histogram
components.description: 24-column CSS-grid bar chart with three hairline gridlines, Sky Blue bars, Signal Mint on hover.
components.css: .hist { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(24, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2px; height: 120px; padding: 0.5rem 0.4rem; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); background-color: rgba(6,10,16,0.32); background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.07), rgba(255,255,255,0.07)), linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.07), rgba(255,255,255,0.07)), linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.07), rgba(255,255,255,0.07)); background-size: 100% 1px; background-position: 0 0, 0 50%, 0 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-origin: content-box; } .hist-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; height: 100%; outline: none; } .hist-track { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; flex: 1; min-height: 0; } .hist-bar { width: 100%; border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #9ec5e8, rgba(158,197,232,0.55)); } .hist-col:hover .hist-bar, .hist-col:focus .hist-bar { background: #6ee7b7; }

components.name: Activity Heat Cell
components.description: One weekday x hour cell; five Sky Blue alpha steps, Signal Mint outline on the peak.
components.css: .heat-cell { min-width: 0; height: clamp(11px, 2vw, 22px); border-radius: 3px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035); } .heat-cell.lvl-1 { background: rgba(158,197,232,0.16); } .heat-cell.lvl-2 { background: rgba(158,197,232,0.3); } .heat-cell.lvl-3 { background: rgba(158,197,232,0.46); } .heat-cell.lvl-4 { background: rgba(158,197,232,0.66); } .heat-cell.lvl-5 { background: #9ec5e8; } .heat-cell.peak { outline: 1px solid #6ee7b7; outline-offset: -1px; }

narrative.overview: plane-stats is a dark instrument panel that happens to be a web page. The ground is near-black with a faint 72px grid that fades at the edges; three low-opacity orbs drift behind it; every panel floats above that ground as a frosted gauge face — a 160° white gradient at 5.5% falling to 1.8%, blurred, with a hairline of light along its top edge and a faint ring set 5px outside it, like the bezel of a cockpit dial. The header is closed by a 1px dashed line: a runway centerline. The voice is night-watch quiet: the screen is looked at in a dark room, at a glance, by one person checking what is overhead and what was new today. The interface never raises its own voice — no illustration, no empty decoration, no second accent. Colour is carried almost entirely by data: Sky Blue for anything actionable or part of a series, Signal Mint for what is live or improving, Emergency Amber for one thing only.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted glass panels over a near-black instrument ground; depth is material, not state.
One cool data hue (Sky Blue), one liveness hue (Signal Mint), one alarm hue (Emergency Amber).
System sans at three registers; mono only for machine strings (hex codes, footer).
Tabular numerals everywhere a value can change.
State changes are colour, border and background — never scale, bounce or translate.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Sky Blue never fills a surface except the one selected chip. It marks data and interaction; it is not a background.

rules.name: The Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber means an emergency squawk. No other state, badge or warning may borrow it.

rules.name: The Mint Rule
rules.body: Mint marks liveness or a broken record. It is not a generic success colour and never appears on a static value.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. A value that shifts the layout when it ticks is a bug.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: No second sans family. If a form control does not inherit the stack, fix the control; do not add a font.

rules.name: The Tracked Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase only at 0.66–0.72rem with at least 0.1em tracking. Body copy and data are never uppercase.

rules.name: The Bezel Rule
rules.body: The 5px-offset outline belongs to .glass panels. Cards, pills, chips and inputs get the inset highlight and nothing else.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Hover and focus change colour, border or background. They never change transform, size or shadow.

dos: Do build every surface from the 160° glass gradient and the 1px hairline stroke; a flat fill is only for the table well and the selected chip.
Do set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every changing value.
Do open each panel with a tracked uppercase eyebrow and its 2px accent bar.
Do use Sky Blue Dim for focus borders and the hex column, full Sky Blue for links and active state.
Do keep the 640px breakpoint the only layout break and let tables scroll inside .table-wrap.
donts: Don't let a form control fall back to the UA font; input.search currently computes to Arial.
Don't use Emergency Amber for anything but emergency squawks.
Don't add scale, translate or bounce transitions.
Don't fill a panel, card or row with Sky Blue.
Don't place a tooltip inside a .glass panel; backdrop-filter makes it the containing block for position: fixed.
Don't add a second sans family, a display serif, or an icon set.
